newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Afghan factions counterattack Taleban militia.
newsitem.headline: Afghan factions counterattack Taleban militia.

text.p: Afghan opposition factions said on Thursday they had launched counterattacks against the Taleban Islamic militia in northern Afghanistan and had retaken some of the territory lost earlier this year.

A Taleban spokesman, quoted by a Pakistan-based private Afghan news service, confirmed fighting north of the capital Kabul but said the attacks by forces led by renowned guerrilla commander Ahmad Shah Masood had been repulsed. The other front where fighting raged between the Taleban and a Shi'ite Moslem militia is in the central province of Bamiyan.
